question.text: At an extreme point of a function $f(x),$ the tangent to the curve is

options.text: inclined at an angle $45^{\circ}$ to the $\mathrm{x}$ -axis
inclined at an angle $60^{\circ}$ to the $x$ -axis

solution.text: At an extreme point of a function $f(x)$, slope is always zero. Thus, At an extreme point of a function $f(x)$, the tangent to the curve is parallel to the x-axis.
